configuration.scope: M1 dispatch, WI-002 enumeration, WI-003 completion, WI-004 sequential generation; local only; WI-005 buffered automatic admission; WI-006 keyed ALLOW_ALL; WI-007 fenced cancel/terminate effects; WI-008 durable manual commands
configuration.recovery: one authenticated completion; an explicit finite suffix, not a liveness proof

tools.lean: v4.24.0; executable draft only; M3 proofs pending

configuration.limits: unsupported ingress rejected; expiry retains ambiguity; no retention eviction in bounded slice

enumeration.independence: bounded second-scan oracle; shares timezone conversion and Farm32 primitives

completion.policy: single-operation SKIP; current pause-on-failure; first completion wins
completion.presence: empty result absent; opaque metadata/null retained; failure presence explicit
completion.integration: local callback event only, no public routing or sequential admission

generation.integration: local root coordinator; separate scan and handoff publication; production routing absent

buffer.overflow: drop automatic arrival and increment BufferDropped; no debit
buffer.drain: shared coordinator; completion reconciles readiness after generation exhausted
buffer.snapshot: queue-time workflow ID and resolved policy; admission-time template, catchup and carryover

allowall.occupancy: one non-ALLOW_ALL blocking owner independent of latest admission
allowall.terminal: Completed tracked or StartOnly settled intent
allowall.capacity_ingress: new automatic admission drops/counts without debit when all records unfinished
allowall.capacity_queue: retain eligible accepted queue; no drain loop; terminal evidence/configuration rechecks readiness
allowall.carryover: ALLOW_ALL clears request fields and never changes carryover or pause
allowall.keyed_loading: only target operation metadata/request on issuance/results; bounded retention scan on admission

effects.unknown_chain: retained awaiting target; no RPC or timer
effects.not_found: settled absent target; not successful cancellation or completion
effects.queue: capacity4; eligible last cancel/terminate replaces unadmitted selection
effects.completion: matching target completion clears effects; RPC outcomes never release blocker

manual.sequence: monotonic uint64 per incarnation; exhaustion rejects
manual.timestamp: exactly representable int64 Unix nanoseconds; supplied time is identity not timer
manual.capacity: fullqueue waits; ALLOW_ALL/free admission wait for slot
manual.eligibility: bypass pause, budget debit, catchup and automatic cursor
manual.dedup: CHASM WithRequestID; bounded framework count/age; independent of start record retention
manual.fairness: WI-009 concrete vacancy lease and operation turn; acceptance pending

backfill_range.scope: WI-009 pending-preserving helper used by coordinator draft
backfill_range.commit: DisposeRange and handoff atomic caller obligation
backfill_range.update: new revision rebase after disposed nominal, never execution now

backfill.transaction: one bounded scan of at most8 probes OR one handoff/disposition
backfill.coordinator: sole owner of automatic/manual/backfill/drain admissions; legacy task handlers stale
backfill.capacity: one durable concrete vacancy lease; operation contention persists at cap4
backfill.turns: queue advances on owner transfer/disposition; operation advances on admission; scan rotates separately
backfill.fairness: conditional on successful fair publication/delivery, adequate recurring capacity and stable definitions; finite model not a cap4 refinement proof
